lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² of land, from NUTS 3 population on 1 January 2025 and land area; a hex shows the area-weighted mean of the regions under its sample points.

lenses.name: Growth
lenses.description: Population change between 1 January 2021 and 1 January 2025, NUTS 3 regions.

lenses.name: Children
lenses.description: Share of the population aged 0–14 on 1 January, NUTS 3 regions (demo_r_pjanind3).

lenses.name: Growth since 2000
lenses.description: Population change between 1 January 2000 and 1 January 2025 (demo_r_pjanaggr3). The long view behind the Growth lens: where Europe has emptied out and where it has filled up over a generation.
lenses.note: Where a NUTS 3 region was redrawn since 2000 it shows the change of its NUTS 2 region (or larger), which has a continuous series. 535 of 1499 regions.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of residents, NUTS 3 regions (demo_r_pjanind3).

lenses.name: Aged 65+
lenses.unit: share of residents aged 65 or over
lenses.description: Share of the population aged 65 or over, NUTS 3 regions (demo_r_pjangrp3).

lenses.name: Born abroad
lenses.unit: share of residents 15–74 born in another country
lenses.description: People aged 15–74 born outside the country they live in (Labour Force Survey, lfst_r_lfsd2pwc).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: GDP per person
lenses.description: GDP at current market prices divided by population, NUTS 3. Counts output where people work, so commuter hubs (Luxembourg, city centres) score far above their surroundings.

lenses.name: GDP per person (PPS)
lenses.description: GDP per inhabitant in purchasing power standards (prices adjusted between countries), NUTS 3.

lenses.name: GDP vs EU average
lenses.description: GDP per inhabitant in purchasing power standards as a percentage of the EU27 average of the same year (nama_10r_3gdp). Has a time dial: press play to watch 2000 to 2025.
lenses.note: Latest year 2023 (2021 for a few regions).

lenses.name: Income
lenses.unit: household disposable income per person, PPS
lenses.description: Net disposable income of private households per inhabitant, in purchasing power standards (nama_10r_2hhinc).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.description: Unemployed as a share of the labour force aged 15–74 (lfst_r_lfu3rt).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Employment rate
lenses.unit: share of people aged 20–64 in work
lenses.description: Employed people as a share of everyone aged 20–64 (lfst_r_lfe2emprt, 2025). Unlike unemployment, it also counts people who are not looking for work. The EU target for 2030 is 78%.
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.unit: share at risk of poverty or social exclusion
lenses.description: People at risk of poverty or social exclusion (AROPE), EU-SILC (ilc_peps11n). Some countries publish only NUTS 1 or national values.
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Degrees
lenses.description: Share of adults aged 25–64 with tertiary education, ISCED 5–8 (edat_lfse_04).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: R&D
lenses.description: Gross domestic expenditure on research and development as a percentage of GDP (rd_e_gerdreg).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: High-tech jobs
lenses.unit: share of jobs in high-tech sectors
lenses.description: Employment in high-technology manufacturing and knowledge-intensive high-tech services (htec_emp_reg2).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Broadband
lenses.description: Households with a broadband internet connection (isoc_r_broad_h; latest regional year, 2021).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Life expectancy
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth (demo_r_mlifexp).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Tourism
lenses.unit: tourist nights per resident per year
lenses.description: Nights spent at hotels, holiday homes and campsites per resident (tour_occ_nin2).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Farm jobs
lenses.unit: share of jobs in agriculture, forestry & fishing
lenses.description: Agriculture, forestry & fishing (NACE A) as a share of all jobs, NUTS 3.

lenses.name: Factory jobs
lenses.description: Manufacturing (NACE C) as a share of all jobs, NUTS 3. Where a country publishes only broader groups, the split follows the parent region.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Tree cover share of the hex’s land samples (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.name: Forest height
lenses.unit: mean canopy height of treed land, metres
lenses.description: How tall the trees are: the mean canopy height of the hex’s ground covered by trees at least 5 m tall (Meta and WRI Global Canopy Height Map, ~25 m cells read on a 1 km lattice).
lenses.note: Hexes where trees cover under 3% of the ground show no value. The model tends to underestimate the tallest forests.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Cropland plus lowland grassland (mostly pasture and meadows) share of the hex’s land samples (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.name: Vineyards
lenses.unit: vineyards as a share of land
lenses.description: Area of farms’ grape vines (for wine and for the table) as a share of the region’s land (Integrated Farm Statistics, ef_lus_allcrops, W1000).
lenses.note: Farm survey 2023 (2020 where newer figures are missing). Published for NUTS 2 regions, so every hex in a region shares its share. No data for the UK, Türkiye and most of the Western Balkans.

lenses.name: Olive groves
lenses.unit: olive groves as a share of land
lenses.description: Area of farms’ olive trees as a share of the region’s land (Integrated Farm Statistics, ef_lus_allcrops, O1000).
lenses.note: Farm survey 2023 (2020 where newer figures are missing). Published for NUTS 2 regions, so every hex in a region shares its share. No data for the UK, Türkiye and most of the Western Balkans.

lenses.name: Orchards
lenses.unit: orchards as a share of land
lenses.description: Area of fruit, berry, nut and citrus plantations as a share of the region’s land (Integrated Farm Statistics, ef_lus_allcrops, F0000 + T0000). Grapes and olives are counted in their own lenses.
lenses.note: Farm survey 2023 (2020 where newer figures are missing). Published for NUTS 2 regions, so every hex in a region shares its share. No data for the UK, Türkiye and most of the Western Balkans.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Built-up share of the hex’s land samples (ESA WorldCover 2021, 10 m buildings and roads read at ~300 m).

lenses.name: Elevation
lenses.description: Mean elevation of the hex’s land samples (AWS Terrain Tiles: SRTM, EU-DEM and others).

lenses.name: Temperature
lenses.description: Mean air temperature 2 m above ground over the year, averaged over 1996–2025.
lenses.note: ERA5-Land reanalysis on a ~9 km grid, averaged over the hex.

lenses.name: Warming
lenses.description: How much warmer 1996–2025 was than 1961–1990, year-round mean temperature.
lenses.note: ERA5-Land reanalysis on a ~9 km grid, averaged over the hex.

lenses.name: Rainfall
lenses.description: Mean yearly precipitation (rain and melted snow), 1996–2025.
lenses.note: ERA5-Land reanalysis on a ~9 km grid, averaged over the hex.

lenses.name: Rainfall change
lenses.description: Yearly precipitation in 1996–2025 against 1961–1990. Brown is drier, green wetter.
lenses.note: ERA5-Land reanalysis on a ~9 km grid, averaged over the hex. Rainfall trends in reanalysis are less certain than temperature trends; read small changes as no change.

lenses.name: Hot days
lenses.description: Days a year when the temperature reaches 30 °C, averaged over 1991–2020 (ERA5, per NUTS 2 region). Has a 2050 dial: push it forward and pick an emissions path.
lenses.note: 1991–2020 average. Open the 2050 dial to see where it is heading.

lenses.name: Tropical nights
lenses.description: Nights a year when the temperature stays above 20 °C, averaged over 1991–2020 (ERA5, per NUTS 2 region). Warm nights are what make heatwaves dangerous. Has a 2050 dial.
lenses.note: 1991–2020 average. Open the 2050 dial to see where it is heading.

lenses.name: Low-lying land
lenses.unit: share of the hex at or below 5 m
lenses.description: Land at or below 5 m within 100 km of the sea. Dykes, dunes and storm surges are not modelled, so this is exposure, not a flood forecast. Elevation from AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM, EU-DEM) at about 300 m, water removed with ESA WorldCover 2021.
lenses.note: About 23 million people live at or below 5 m.
